notes: KOH-activated carbons from hydrochars of coal discards and sewage sludge; H2 isotherms by Micromeritics HPVA (volumetric) at 77 K and 273 K up to 3.5 MPa (Figs. 8, 9). Carbon majority holds for all three H2-measured ACs, but narrowly for AC-HCT (C 51.16 wt%, ash 40.86 wt%, adb, Table 6); AC-HCS and AC-HCB are about 71 wt% C. The text calls Figs. 8 and 9 'volumetric and gravimetric measurement results', but the only H2 method described is the volumetric HPVA; Fig. 9 shows the uptake in wt%. The paper does not say its H2 values were published before, and nothing indicates retraction. Bracketed sample names in the I4 quote mark Table 6 column headers.
